headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Tata Consultancy Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
summary: Q2 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹73,188 Cr (+11.2% YoY, +1.3% QoQ); EBITDA (derived) ₹18,815 Cr (+4.7% YoY, margin 25.7%); PAT ₹13,934 Cr (+14.9% YoY, +3.8% QoQ).
raw_text: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

derivation.basis_note: Consolidated Statement of Financial Results (PDF p. 8, reported in ₹ crore). Columns L→R: Col 1='September 30, 2026', Col 2='June 30, 2026', Col 3='September 30, 2025' (mapped Current=Col 1, Previous=Col 2, Year-Ago=Col 3).
derivation.revenue_definition: Printed row 'Revenue from operations' (Net of GST) (excludes Other Income of ₹1,337.00 Cr) = ₹73,188.00 Cr (Prev Q: ₹72,275.00 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹65,799.00 Cr).
derivation.ebitda_formula: Derived (`derived`): Operating Profit (Revenue ₹73,188.00 Cr − Total Expenses ₹55,887.00 Cr + Finance Costs ₹252.00 Cr = ₹17,553.00 Cr) + D&A (₹1,262.00 Cr) = ₹18,815.00 Cr (25.71% margin; Prev Q: ₹18,556.00 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹17,978.00 Cr).
derivation.pbt_basis: Printed row 'PROFIT BEFORE TAX' (after exceptional items) = ₹18,638.00 Cr (Prev Q: ₹17,944.00 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹16,068.00 Cr; PBT before exceptional items = ₹18,638.00 Cr, Current Q exceptional item = ₹0.00 Cr).
derivation.pat_basis: Printed row 'PROFIT FOR THE PERIOD' (Total Consolidated Profit after tax) = ₹13,934.00 Cr (Profit attributable to Owners of the Company/Parent = ₹13,884.00 Cr; Non-controlling interest = ₹50.00 Cr).

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ crore (Page 8) · EBITDA derived
